name: claude-design-skills
description: Skills for designing software and for making the code: design interviews, decision records and a project lexicon; code style and the pre-PR review cycle; a guard hook for protected paths

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Interview-driven software design: takes a rough pitch to a complete, gap-free design tree, then captures it as specs, contracts, and ADRs. Carries a lexicon and an assumptions record across a project's lifetime; everything else it writes is the feature's brief.

plugins.name: implementation
plugins.description: How the code gets made: how names and comments read, and the pre-PR review cycle, with fresh-context reviewers by lens, and lenses a repository adds as skills of its own.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Makes a change to a repository's protected paths, such as its architecture tests, reach the author: a hook asks before any edit or shell write to a path the repository lists, with a message telling the agent to record a provisional closure and stop.
